record.title: Validate stock token wire codec and ordinary option persistence
record.intent: Prove the stock low-nibble-first token encoding, then test negative, acceptance and guest persistence with unchanged validation.
requirements: Preserve the prior negative and positive rejection results. The static hypothesis is stock API_SetStr2Hex consumes low-nibble-first lowercase pairs, unlike the original conventional ciphertext hex.

Freeze a separately identified corrected synthetic fixture. Before installation, use the actual stock decoder to show conventional encoding produces the predicted nibble-swapped bytes and corrected encoding recovers the exact AES ciphertext. Stop on disagreement.

Observe the actual installer consumer decoder and AES key/plaintext boundaries without replacing them. Tie validator returns to the installer invocation rather than initialization calls. No changed key derivation, validator returns or option-query results.
Retain the corrected ARM64 directory preflight and all existing native/artifact guards.
Commit and push tasking before execution. Use the recovered synthetic fixture contract and unchanged stock APK/native inputs; exclude acquired unit key, vendor and calibration files.

Preserve real ART/JNI/factory and actual model/serial setters. Model only the declared DNA driver output and file backing for stock private serialization. Keep validation, ordinary installer, queries and notifications unchanged.

Validate stock crypto roundtrips, synthetic identity, empty private-store baseline, actual License initialization and complete active-catalog query state before any install. Stop on an unsatisfied prerequisite.

Execute at most one wrong-name negative arm from clean state. Require actual validator rejection, false FlexA query and no FlexA license file. Preserve counter/file deltas and commit the conclusion before the positive arm.

Only after the negative control passes, execute one positive arm from independently clean state. Require actual stock validation and activeOpt result, success notification, true query and stock-written license file; outer return zero alone is insufficient.
Preserve stock-produced private bytes with explicit flush and fsync, guarded complete serialization and exact reload roundtrip. Label this harness-directed persistence, not automatic FRAM scheduling.

On positive acceptance, start a fresh process on retained guest storage and then reboot the same guest and repeat. Prove boot identity changed; do not reinstall, regenerate key/license files or format private state during reload phases.

Seal phase sources, journals, file snapshots, tool/input hashes and guest health. A prerequisite failure closes that actual question for evaluation; do not alter tokens or native return values to force success. No physical contact or D-capability patch.
acceptance: The two-arm installer and persistence outcome is established
or a precise first prerequisite failure is preserved for deliberate continuation.
